description: Twelve rows that pass a signal straight through, each with a label you can type into, so a group of modules has one place to be patched

inputs.text: Takes a signal in on the right-hand side of a row marked inputs and passes it unchanged to the jack at the other end of that row
Takes a signal in on the left-hand side of a row marked outputs and passes it unchanged to the jack at the other end of that row

outputs.text: Carries, unchanged, whatever is patched into the jack at the other end of its row
Carries, unchanged, whatever is patched into the jack at the other end of its row

notes: click a row's grey field and type to name what that row carries, up to sixteen characters; the names are saved with the patch
nothing is changed on the way through, and with a row's input empty that row's output is held at 0V
the top six rows are lettered inputs and the bottom six outputs, which is a convention for patching a group from one side and out of the other; both sets work the same way
